lines.text: I drew this last night. An old-time water-balance lift.
The box hangs on one end of a rope. A bucket hangs on the other.
Fill the bucket with water... it gets heavy, it goes down... and the box goes UP.
Heavy side goes down. The other side goes up.
Like a seesaw on a rope. That's a counterweight.
And when something heavy hangs on a rope: never stand underneath.
The stream, Granny. All day, for free.
Tomorrow... we let the river do the lifting.
